build_make_request: build a python request envelope with type token and payload for the google meet node rpc protocol
create_make_response: create a success response envelope with a request id and payload dict for the rpc protocol
create_make_error: create an error envelope with a request id and error message string for the rpc protocol
encode_message: encode a message envelope dict into a compact JSON string using the protocol encode function
decode_message: decode a raw JSON string into a validated message envelope dict using the protocol decode function
